facts.fact: Expansão reports AGT's chair saying the tax authority's machine-learning tools, tested since 2024, cross-checked 2025 corporate income tax filings and flagged irregular filers, who were then sent messages to correct them.
Expansão reports AGT's chair saying the AI found that 15,000 of 40,000 companies that filed zero-turnover 2025 income tax returns had in fact recorded transactions.
